general.description: Eris'snell is the first Slingshot-station constructed by the Baartish. Build around the year 2225, it took at least 8 years to achieve it. It orbit around Tshonaal, near the Baartish Moonworld.
general.bar: High-masters and Counter-masters waiting for the next flight in the stylized Hall of Eris'snell, crafted in the pure style Neo-Biishama.
